title: Warehouse Structure
description: Field-by-field structural documentation for a Shippers Group warehouse or distribution center record

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse facility. Used to reference the facility across shipment, inventory, and order records.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable name for the warehouse or distribution center (e.g., 'Dallas Distribution Center #1').

fields.name: address
fields.description: Physical location of the warehouse facility.

fields.name: street2
fields.description: Secondary address line (suite, dock number, etc.)

fields.name: city
fields.description: City where the facility is located

fields.name: state
fields.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g., TX, GA, PA)

fields.name: zip
fields.description: US ZIP code or ZIP+4 code

fields.name: squareFootage
fields.description: Total square footage of the warehouse or distribution center. The Shippers Group operates over 5 million square feet across 12 locations.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Warehouse type classification: ambient (dry goods), refrigerated, frozen, hazmat (hazardous materials), or co-packing.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: List of logistics services offered at this facility. A facility may offer multiple capabilities.
items: warehousing - standard storage and inventory management
distribution - outbound order fulfillment and shipment
fulfillment - e-commerce or direct-to-consumer order processing
transportation-management - carrier coordination and freight management
cross-docking - inbound to outbound without storage
pick-and-pack - order picking and packing services

fields.name: certifications
fields.description: Industry certifications held by the facility, such as SQF, AIB, ISO 9001, or FSMA compliance.

fields.name: operatingHours
fields.description: Operating hours for the facility by day of week. Hours are expressed in local facility time.

fields.name: contactName
fields.description: Name of the primary contact person for the facility.

fields.name: contactPhone
fields.description: Direct phone number for the facility.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the facility record was created.

fields.name: updatedAt
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the facility record was last updated.
